assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square standalone character illustration for Notebook Pets, a Discord virtual pet game. Generate ONE original character, not a sheet. Subject from the project's prompt: baby form, very round and small, oversized head; plant creature with leaf sprouts on its head and a vine tail; green color theme and leaf patterns. A lovable tiny rounded soft-green plant monster, two expressive sparkling eyes, tiny paws, a clear sprout crown and a gracefully curled vine tail, adorable friendly smile. Style: polished Japanese collectible-monster game character art, kawaii chibi mascot, soft rounded plush-like body, pastel candy colors, glossy sticker shading, clean confident bold lineart with subtle light watercolor coloring. 'Notebook doodle aesthetic' means the charming hand-drawn quality of the CHARACTER ONLY, not a literal notebook or paper scene. Composition: full body including tail, centered at 75 percent of a square canvas, generous clean margins, three-quarter view, instantly readable at Discord thumbnail size. Backdrop: plain pure white, tiny soft grounding shadow only. No notebook, desk, paper, scenery, props, grid, extra creatures, evolution panels, lettering, logos or watermark. Finished production illustration, charming distinct silhouette, crisp edges, restrained details. 1024x1024 square.
